conventions.wire_ids: Cut-list v3 IDs. Suffixes: g=ground return, r=5V ref, s=shield drain. INJ_PWR/COIL_PWR/COIL_GND are addendum bus rails.
conventions.total_amps: Sum of device nameplate amps (worst-case simultaneous peak). Coils/injectors are peak not continuous. Pass-through devices (controllers feeding actuators) noted to avoid double-count.
conventions.pdm_channels: PDM30:OUTn from cut list FROM column. 'PDM30:unspecified' = cut list says PDM30 with no channel.

meta.wire_accounting: All 123 original + 22 companion wire IDs assigned exactly once. All 141 devices assigned exactly once (2 non-electrical excluded into NON_ELECTRICAL).

CORE_ENGINE.swap_axis: engine_type (LS3 V8 today; swapping engine swaps coil/injector count, sensor pinouts, ETB connector — structure stays)
CORE_ENGINE.amps_note: Peak; coils 32A + injectors 32A are pulsed, continuous draw far lower. ETB 5A, WB controller 3A, ECU 2A.

FUEL.amps_note: 35A is the Fuel Pressure Regulator (PWM pump controller) feed — the pump draws through it. Relay coil 0.2A, level sender 0.01A.
gaps: Fuel Pump itself is in the cut list (#66, 8 AWG) but has NO device entry in devices.json
Fuel Pressure Regulator has no cut-list wire ID

CHARGING_STARTING.amps_note: 200A = starter cranking peak. Alternator is 220A SOURCE (output), not load. All 0 AWG M22759/16 direct battery runs — no PDM channels.

BRAKES_IBOOSTER.toggle_note: Toggling off implies vacuum/hydroboost alternative — iBooster feed (#52, 8 AWG) and relay (#95) drop.
BRAKES_IBOOSTER.cross_dependency: Brake Light Switch (#53, ECU digital input) also feeds LIGHTING_EXTERIOR brake lamps and TRANS_6L80E torque-converter unlock — keep #53 if either of those is on, even with iBooster off.

EPARKING_BRAKE.amps_note: Actuator (10A) draws through controller — not double-counted. #54 = 16 AWG PDM feed to controller.
gaps: E-Stopp Dash Switch and Actuator legs have no own cut-list IDs — only the #54 controller feed exists

TRANS_6L80E.swap_axis: trans_type (manual swap drops controller #58 + NSS; reverse switch + t-case indicator survive any swap)
TRANS_6L80E.cross_dependency: Reverse Light Switch (#57) feeds LIGHTING_EXTERIOR backup lights and CAMERA_REAR trigger.

pdm_channels: OUT15 (backup/3rd brake — shared with rear camera)
gaps: Floor Dimmer Switch has no cut-list wire ID
Door Puddle Lights have no cut-list wire IDs

POWER_WINDOWS.routing_note: Wires 34/35 carry door_crossing flag (+6in boot flex) — depends on Door Jamb Boots (HARNESS_INFRA).

AUDIO.amps_note: Amp 30A (8 AWG feed #32), head unit 3A, relay coil 0.2A. Speaker wires carry no battery amps.

AMP_STEPS.amps_note: 8A x 3 nameplate; steps typically run sequentially through controller — realistic peak ~16A.

pdm_channels: OUT15 (SHARED with backup lights — camera powers up with reverse; intentional coupling, but means CAMERA_REAR off does not free OUT15 if LIGHTING_EXTERIOR is on)
CAMERA_REAR.cross_dependency: Video display lands on Radio/Head Unit (AUDIO) or Display/Dash — camera without a screen is dead weight.

gaps: SGI-100BT and GPS Antenna have no cut-list wire IDs — SGI needs CAN tap (#62 backbone) + power/ground; flag for cut-list v4
DASH_CLUSTER_DAKOTA.data_note: Cluster data arrives over CAN via SGI-100BT bridge from MoTeC — no analog sender wires in this configuration.

ACCESSORY_12V.note: Horn parked here — no HORN subsystem was defined and it is a discretionary accessory load.

EXHAUST_CUTOUTS_QTP.reason: QTP cutouts + polarity relays exist in devices.json but fit no requested subsystem.
gaps: ZERO cut-list wires for this entire subsystem — cut-list v4 work item
Relay-to-cutout assignment unconfirmed (assumed 2 polarity relays per cutout for open/close reversal)

HARNESS_INFRA.note: Always built; scales with whatever subsystems are selected. Not a toggle — a substrate.
dependency_rules: Door Jamb Boots required if any of POWER_WINDOWS, POWER_LOCKS, AUDIO (front speakers), DOME_COURTESY (door switches/puddles) is on
Rear Harness Junction required if any of FUEL, AUDIO (rear), LIGHTING_EXTERIOR (rear), CAMERA_REAR, EPARKING_BRAKE, AMP_STEPS is on
Firewall Bulkhead (61-pin D38999) sized by count of engine-bay-crossing circuits — recompute on toggle change

NON_ELECTRICAL.note: 0 pins, no signal — present in devices.json but not harness items. Excluded from all electrical totals.

MECHANICAL_GAUGES_ALTERNATE.description: If mechanical gauges are chosen alongside OR instead of Dakota cluster. ECU-side sensors NEVER come out — they are engine-protection inputs to the M130. Mechanical gauges need their OWN senders/ports.

second_sender_adds.device: Oil Pressure Sender (gauge) — NOT in devices.json, add it
second_sender_adds.mechanical_option: capillary tube to gauge — ZERO new wires, needs oil galley tee or second port
second_sender_adds.electric_gauge_option: 1x 22 AWG signal wire dash-to-block (~4.6ft engine loom run) + gauge lighting feed
second_sender_adds.physical_requirement: tee fitting or second galley port — two senders cannot share one port

second_sender_adds.device: Water Temp Sender (gauge) — NOT in devices.json, add it
second_sender_adds.mechanical_option: capillary bulb to gauge — ZERO new wires, needs second port in head/manifold/water pump housing
second_sender_adds.electric_gauge_option: 1x 22 AWG signal wire dash-to-engine (~4.6ft) + gauge lighting feed
second_sender_adds.physical_requirement: second coolant port — capillary bulb and ECU CLT cannot share

rewire: Fuel Level Sender #98 currently runs to ECU — analog fuel gauge needs the sender wired direct to gauge, with ohm-range match (GM 0-90 ohm vs gauge spec)
Speedometer: mechanical cable from transfer case OR keep VSS #100 (ECU still wants it regardless)

if_alongside_dakota.add_note: Only the two doubled senders above + their ports. Net new wires: 0 (capillary) to 2 (electric senders).

OUT25: Dome (DOME_COURTESY) + Footwell/Under-Dash/Underhood/Cargo (LIGHTING_INTERIOR) — channel frees only when BOTH subsystems are off
OUT13: Tail Lights + both front Parking Lights
OUT19: all 5 markers + 3 clearance + license plate
